{{Quote|T/I Gamma, there is a Corellian transport trying to escape!|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''''Neenoc''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] that was present at [[XQ3 Platform]] [[AZ 77]] when the platform was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]], [[Implacable (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Implacable'']].
